headline: S&P Global Ratings Maintains Credit Rating for Boston Mayflower Finance PLC
summary: S&P Global Ratings has affirmed the 'A-' issuer credit rating and 'bbb+' Stand Alone Credit Profile for Boston Mayflower Finance PLC following an annual review.
